map.管理出租房产的租约到期提醒，按剩余天数颜色分级预警，追踪续签状态，提供房东行动建: Manage lease-expiry reminders for rental properties, with color-graded warnings by remaining days, track renewal status and provide landlord action suggestions.
map.📖 查看「租期（起止/续签）提醒 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Lease Term (Start/End/Renewal) Reminder
map.📚 深度解析：租期到期提醒与续签跟踪: 📚 Deep Dive: Lease Expiry Reminder and Renewal Tracking
map.管理多套出租房时登记每套的租期起止与租客联系方式，按剩余天数自动排序预警。: When managing multiple rentals, register each lease start/end and tenant contact; auto-sort and warn by remaining days.
map.到期前 30 天开始跟进续签意向，避免空置期损失。: Start following up on renewal intent 30 days before expiry, to avoid vacancy-period losses.
map.退租结算时把月租金与剩余天数结合，估算提前解约的违约金或应退租金。: At move-out settlement, combine the monthly rent with remaining days to estimate the early-termination penalty or refundable rent.
map.距到期 <0 天显示\"已过期\"；<7 天红色；<30 天橙色；<90 天黄色: Days to expiry <0 shows "expired"; <7 days red; <30 days orange; <90 days yellow; ≥90 days green. For example a property with monthly rent 4,500 CNY and lease until 2026-10-05, if viewed on 2026-09-20 (15 days left) it is an orange warning and you should immediately contact the tenant to confirm renewal; if left unhandled until 10-06 it turns to "expired" and must be handled per the overdue clause in the contract.
map.纯前端保存在浏览器本地，不会上传到服务器。换设备或清理浏览器数据后记录会丢失，重: Stored locally in the browser, never uploaded to servers. Records are lost after switching devices or clearing browser data; please back up important leases separately.
map.可以同时管理多套房源吗？: Can multiple properties be managed at once?
map.可以。逐条添加地址、租客、月租金、起止日期与电话，列表会按剩余天数排序并分别着色: Yes. Add address, tenant, monthly rent, start/end dates and phone one by one; the list sorts by remaining days and colors each, easing centralized follow-up.
map.绿色=剩余>90天，黄色=30-90天，橙色=7-30天，红色=<7天: Green = remaining >90 days, yellow = 30–90 days, orange = 7–30 days, red = <7 days
map.已过期租约会以红色高亮显示: Expired leases are highlighted in red
map.建议在租期结束前60天开始与租客沟通续签事宜: It is recommended to start communicating renewal with the tenant 60 days before lease end
map.数据保存在浏览器本地，清除浏览器缓存会丢失: Data is stored locally in the browser; clearing the browser cache will lose it
map.出租房产租约到期提醒管理工具。记录租约起止日期，按剩余天数颜色分级预警（绿/黄/: A lease-expiry reminder management tool for rental properties. Records lease start/end dates, color-graded warnings by remaining days (green/yellow/orange/red), tracks renewal status and provides landlord action suggestions.
map.续签状态追踪（待沟通/已续签/不续签）: Renewal status tracking (to contact / renewed / not renewing)
map.如：朝阳区xx路1号: E.g.: No.1 xx Road, Chaoyang District
